title: Lightly Crisp Korean Vine Tomatoes Gimbap
description: A kid-friendly Korean dish featuring vine tomatoes and double-rise-bread, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, in the form of gimbap.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the double-rise-bread cubes until lightly browned.
Prepare the vine tomatoes by slicing them into thin pieces.
Mix the sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Add the toasted bread cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Add the sliced vine tomatoes to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
Cut the seaweed sheets into smaller pieces to fit the gimbap shape.
Place a small amount of the bread and tomato mixture onto a seaweed sheet and roll into a gimbap shape.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients.
Serve the gimbap immediately and enjoy.
